title: Auto-resume a turn that failed with "Selected model is at capacity"
outcome: When an agent turn ends with "Turn failed: Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model.", TermAl resumes the session's work by itself once the model is available again, instead of leaving the session stopped until a person resumes it.
acceptance: Auto-resume a turn that failed with "Selected model is at capacity" is done
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1b, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DUP. Greg's provider-limits decision (2026-10-05, Advisor #272) folds this into the transient-availability retry, w-66f2ced7d7b9 (P3).
